references.title: 2022 American College of Rheumatology/American Association of Hip and Knee Surgeons Guideline for the Perioperative Management of Antirheumatic Medication in Patients With Rheumatic Diseases Undergoing Elective Total Hip or Total Knee Arthroplasty
references.quote_excerpt: For patients with RA, AS, PsA, JIA, or all SLE undergoing THA or TKA, continuing the usual dosing of the following disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs) through surgery is conditionally recommended: methotrexate, leflunomide, hydroxychloroquine, sulfasalazine, and/or apremilast.
references.quote_translation_excerpt: RA / AS / PsA / JIA / SLE 全患者で 待機的 人工膝/股関節全置換術を受ける場合、 メトトレキサート / レフルノミド / ヒドロキシクロロキン / スルファサラジン / アプレミラスト の 通常用量継続を条件付きで推奨 (Table 2 上段、 Recommended timing = Anytime)
references.location_in_source: p.4 Table 2 上段 (DMARDs: continue through surgery, all patients) + p.5 Recommendations
